identity.real_world_identity_notes: AMS2's generic Kartcross, a single 0.6-litre model introduced with the Adrenaline Pack that brought dirt racing to the game. No specific real-world chassis is identified.

wheel_rim.notes: Observed from the cockpit during the guided drive.

notes: Simulator behaviour was directly observed in a guided drive in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled: clutch-free move-off, automatic cut on upshifts and no automatic blip, so the driver supplies the downshift blip.
No real-world chassis is identified and the reference states no transmission, so the gearbox type is the sequential the drive observed rather than a sourced claim.
This class reports a single configuration; the selection screen offers no aero package and only the plain identity has been observed.
Observed live in AMS2 1.6.9.91 via guided verification observation ams2.kart-cross.20260816t034844362z-96cd83b9 by Jason Kinslow.

confidence.basis: Simulator behaviour was live-tested in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled, and the real-world transmission is supported by registered sources.

claims.basis: A registered reference establishes the class and its single generic model, and the exact simulator identity was observed live.
The reference gives a 0.6-litre engine but no transmission, so the six sequential gears, automatic cut and absent automatic blip rest on the guided drive alone.
Directly observed during the guided drive: move-off, shift clutch use, automatic cut and blip, and the cockpit rim.

deviations.basis: The guided drive moved the car off with no clutch input, where the archetype's cars stall without it. No real-world chassis is identified for AMS2's generic Kartcross, so the gearbox is what the drive showed rather than a sourced claim.
